bioghist.head: Biography
bioghist.p: Gavin Lambert was born July 23, 1924 in Sussex, England. Lambert was a screenwriter, author, and one-time director. His first book "The Slide Area" was published in 1959. His screenplays include "Sons and Lovers" and "Inside Daisy Clover", which was adapted from his book of the same title. He also wrote several bibliographies including "Nazimova," "Natalie Wood: A Life," and "Mainly About Lindsay Anderson." Mr. Lambert died [July 17, 2005], in Los Angeles, at aged 80.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Content
scopecontent.p: This collection consists of books, audiovisual recordings, and other materials written by Lambert, including "Inside Daisy Clover" and two uncorrected proofs of "Natalie Wood: A Life." Included is Gavin Lambert's copy of "Another Sky," the only film he both wrote and directed.
